goal3.title: Strategy Goal 3: equal and effective cancer care

indicators.label: Five-year survival of poor-prognosis cancers reaches the Nordic level
indicators.detail: Targets versus the 2023 NORDCAN level: lung +14 percentage points, pancreas +6, liver +14. Nordic level = average of Sweden and Norway.
indicators.source: National Cancer Strategy 2026-2035 (strategy PDF, read directly)

indicators.label: Cancer mortality falls 10%
indicators.detail: From about 13,300 deaths a year, so about 1,330 fewer. 13,490 cancer deaths were recorded in 2024.

indicators.label: Patients reach treatment within target times
indicators.detail: Median diagnosis-to-treatment 36-38 days (2018-2022); under 2% (600-700 patients) exceeded 180 days in 2024.

lung_survival.title: Lung cancer five-year relative survival, %
lung_survival.source: IHE Cancer Dashboard Finland 2026 via team notes; not re-verified. NORDCAN is the primary source to check.

recommendations.action: Record stage for at least 90% of cancers and set up the national quality registry
recommendations.evidence: Stage is known for only 42% of cases, so the strategy's 70% stage I-II target cannot be tracked [N]; the strategy calls for a quality registry [S].

recommendations.action: Publish a county 'pathway clock': days from first symptom visit to imaging and to diagnosis, by municipality
recommendations.evidence: Finnish data on symptom-to-diagnosis time by region do not exist; the largest delay is before diagnosis [N]. Breast cancer survival varies more within hospital districts than between them, which the Cancer Registry's researcher links to primary-care access or referral delays in some municipalities (via team notes) [N].
recommendations.kpi: Median and 90th-percentile days, per health centre

recommendations.action: Agree a fast pathway from health centre to chest CT for defined red-flag symptoms (persistent cough, haemoptysis) with a referral-to-CT time standard
recommendations.evidence: Health centres cannot order CT directly, so a specialist referral comes first [N, mentor]. IHE recommends expanding CT use in primary care [N]. Finland waits are longest in the Nordics for symptom appointment and specialist consultation [N].
recommendations.kpi: Days from first visit to CT; share of red-flag patients scanned within an agreed time

recommendations.action: Close participation gaps in existing screening: interpreters and outreach for language minorities, targeted effort in low-attending metropolitan areas and low-education groups
recommendations.evidence: Participation 53-61% for other native language vs 75-83% domestic across programmes; primary education 62-64% vs tertiary 79-86%; lowest counties Helsinki, Vantaa-Kerava, West Uusimaa [S].
recommendations.kpi: 80% in every county; language-minority ratio of at least 0.85 (now 0.72-0.74)

recommendations.action: Run a two-year pilot of targeted lung LDCT delivery in one county, randomising invitations to measure how many scans a mobile or pop-up site adds
recommendations.owner: One county with a research partner; AstraZeneca interested in a follow-up
recommendations.evidence: NELSON and NLST show lung mortality reduction with LDCT in heavy smokers [S]; Finland has no public programme [S]; whether a truck adds participants is unknown and is the pilot's question [A]. Use the planner on the map page.
recommendations.kpi: Additional participants (uptake difference), minority uptake ratio, extra-imaging rate, time from positive scan to work-up

recommendations.action: Train primary-care staff in early diagnosis of lung and other low-symptom cancers
recommendations.evidence: Only seven EU+2 countries offer early-diagnosis training for primary care (OECD, via team notes) [N]; early lung cancer often has no symptoms [general clinical knowledge].
recommendations.kpi: Share of primary-care staff trained; red-flag CT referrals

data_status.item: Lung-cancer deaths by wellbeing county, 2021-2025 (ICD-10 C32-C34)
data_status.how: Statistics Finland table 13u5 (read via API). Includes larynx. Crude counts and rates; no age-standardisation by county in this table.
data_status.action: Optionally request age-standardised county rates from the Cancer Registry.

data_status.item: Lung deaths per 100,000 aged 50-74 by county
data_status.how: All-age deaths divided by the 50-74 population, so counties with older populations look worse.

data_status.item: Daily smoking by county, ages 20-64 and 65+
data_status.how: THL Sotkanet indicators 4405 and 4406, survey year 2024.
data_status.action: Ask THL for 50-74 and for former smokers.

data_status.item: Eligible high-risk people (age 50-74, >=20 pack-years, current or quit within 15 years) by municipality
data_status.how: Verified smoking prevalence x an assumed factor k (0.8; range 0.55-1.1). Central national estimate about 120,000, or 7% of people aged 50-74.
data_status.action: Get the Finnish pack-year distribution (THL FinSote/Terve Suomi microdata via Findata).
Request from THL / Findata. This is the main uncertainty in the eligible estimate.

data_status.how: Researched list of 36 towns (24 confirmed by a source, 12 likely). No national register found; private providers and many regional hospitals missing.
data_status.action: Ask counties for their CT unit lists; STUK holds radiation-source licences.

data_status.how: Not found. Eurostat national hospital CT exams per 100,000 swing between 3,300 and 9,300 over 2019-2024 (series breaks), so the model uses 35-90 per 1,000 inhabitants as a range.
data_status.action: Request CT volumes by county from THL (Hilmo/Avohilmo) or the counties.

data_status.how: None found. The model assumes 4 weeks at baseline (range 2-8). 'Longest waits' on this page are MODELLED added waits under the capacity assumptions, not observed waits.
data_status.action: Request imaging waiting times from counties; enter them in data/area/ct_waits.csv (template provided) and they replace the assumption.

data_status.item: Screening participation by county and group (breast, colorectal, cervical)
data_status.how: Cancer Registry annual statistics tables, 2024 (read directly).

data_status.item: Effect of a campaign on uptake and on demand from people who are not eligible
data_status.how: +30% relative uptake and 3% of non-eligible people 50-74 seeking a scan, per unit of campaign intensity. No evidence found.
data_status.action: Treat as scenarios; measure in the pilot.

data_status.item: Whether a mobile or pop-up site adds scans (additionality)
data_status.how: Unknown; it is the pilot's primary question.
